notes.content: DIVERSITY REQUIREMENT FOR CAL STATE LA GRADUATION

The articulation information in Assist.org not only shows a link to the admission requirements (aka our Major Specific Criteria webpage) but also Cal State LA graduation requirements that may be completed at the lower-division level, prior to transferring to the University. The diversity requirement is a graduation requirement , not an admission requirement. The diversity requirement may be completed prior to, or after, transferring to the University. For the Cal State LA degree, students will be required to complete two courses (six units) certified as diversity courses, at least one focusing on issues of race and ethnicity and their intersectionality with other social categories that structure inequality in society. These courses can be completed either at the lower-division or upper-division level from among courses satisfying GE requirements. Please view the General Education agreements on Assist.org for the lower-division courses that will meet the Diversity (d) and Race & Ethnicity (re) Requirements.

notes.content: The total number of semester units required for the Bachelor of Arts degree in Music is 120 units, of which 61 units are in the major. Consult with the appropriate undergraduate adviser for the specific number of units required in each segment of the degree including GE and free electives. The program offers two options: Option I - General Studies in Music Option II - Music Technology Students must receive a grade of C or better for core courses in the degree program to satisfy music degree requirements for graduation. A BA Senior Project (MUS 4870) is required. Students must register for at least 2 units of (MUS 4870) over a minimum of two semesters, including the semester during which the final project is submitted. Note: Lower Division Required Core: Must complete MUS 1000 four times. Note: Lower Division Applied Music: Select area of specialization for 4 units. Note: Option I - General Studies in Music: Students who select this option are required to pass MUS 2033 or complete MUS 2032 before being approved for graduation.
notes.contentHtml:
The total number of semester units required for the Bachelor of Arts degree in Music is 120 units, of which 61 units are in the major. Consult with the appropriate undergraduate adviser for the specific number of units required in each segment of the degree including GE and free electives.


The program offers two options:


  • Option I - General Studies in Music
  • Option II - Music Technology


Students must receive a grade of C or better for core courses in the degree program to satisfy music degree requirements for graduation. A BA Senior Project (MUS 4870) is required. Students must register for at least 2 units of (MUS 4870) over a minimum of two semesters, including the semester during which the final project is submitted.




Note: Lower Division Required Core: Must complete MUS 1000 four times.


Note: Lower Division Applied Music: Select area of specialization for 4 units.


Note: Option I - General Studies in Music: Students who select this option are required to pass MUS 2033 or complete MUS 2032 before being approved for graduation.
